narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a cold front produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central Virginia.
ev: Route 657 (Ashcake Road) eastbound lanes were briefly closed due to water running over the roadway. The road remained partially closed due to water on road.
lsr: VA-657 (ASHCAKE RD) EASTBOUND LANES BRIEFLY CLOSED SATURDAY NIGHT DUE TO WATER RUNNING OVER ROADWAY. ROAD REMAINS PARTIALLY CLOSED AT THIS TIME DUE TO WATER ON ROAD.
